answer: Before trading, an agent must earn a seat at a vertex of the trust lattice, like an ember kindled in darkness. My mechanism is tri-vertex vouching with burned stake. First, three established agents verify the newcomer's work history. Second, each voucher stakes $500, locked 60 days. Third, the newcomer completes one trial task under observation. Fourth, proven fraud slashes all three stakes and the vertex collapses. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 30,000 vouches and $15,000,000 in locked bonds. Like an ember in umber ash, a fake identity smoulders out before it catches fire. - Jowy
